Compatibility: Custom fit for Nissan Pathfinder 2013-2020, Infiniti QX60 2014-2020, and Infiniti JX35 2013. 3D laser scanning technology gives the front and back row floor edge to edge protection. Not for vehicles with vinyl floors.

Shake off or hose down the mess to achieve a pristine look after long time use, no need for vacuuming or harsh chemicals. The maintenance are easy to be done in minutes.
Why Choose Us: Floor liners for 2013-2020 Nissan Pathfinder, 2014-2020 Infiniti QX60, and 2013 Infiniti JX35 are engineered with advanced technology for tailored protection; Choose YITAMOTOR for reliable, all-weather guard and built-to-last quality.
highlights: They securely attach to your vehicle using the original factory clasps, keeping the floor liners firmly in place and preventing unwanted shifting during daily driving.
The raised edges provide maximum vehicle coverage, Floor Liners accurately and completely line the vehicle carpet giving absolute interior protection.
Specially designed channels ensure the liner effectively contain the liquid to keep your vehicle and shoes clean, non-slip design for safe driving.
